Update 11/20/2025 Played another 10 hours since the 1.1.2.0 update. The gunplay feels a lot better, being more consistent from gunfight to gunfight. Other issues I listed have not been addressed thus far, but I'm hopeful for more fixes in the future. Can't recommend this game until they fix these glaring issues: -Whether your bullets make it to what you're shooting at seems completely random. There is zero consistency from game to game. -Damage fall off at range is steep and feels completely random. You'll likely get 7-8 hit markers while tap-firing an AR beyond 50m before the guy drops. -Headshots are effectively meaningless. You'll have to get 3-4 headshots with most weapons to drop anyone. -Weapons not being class-locked means you'll see everyone running around with the meta guns. -ARs will be consistently out-ranged by SMGs, will also be beat in close range by LMGs panic firing from the hip. -If you choose to play smaller games (CQB) you will spawn 2-3x in a row right in someone's line of sight. -Lobbies and squads will disband after every match, losing any sense of team cohesion. This means you might be on offense for rush or breakthrough 5-6x in a row. At it's core, BF6 has a good foundation and could be great, but these issues make it a frustrating experience.

All the maps are literally the same designs with slight variations aside from the new one introduced in season 2 recently. Yeah I can see why the player count continues to decline. Even season 2 couldn't help it lol not even a slight bump in player numbers lmao. Also terrible balance changes. Why even nerf the suppressor? Actually, why run anything other than suppressors? 3d in-world spotting is stupid af you don't even have to be spotted anymore with Q it just happens when you fire your gun if you run it loud lol. They really gave ya'll ONE new map after a whole season hahaha what a joke. If you REALLY just need to scratch a bf itch then wait for this pos to go on sale for like $20, but even then there's far better games to be had even at that price point. Can't comment on REDSEC or w/e the other modes are since I came here to play battlefield not another cookie cutter battle royale slop.
